readings.names: Pir (that casing only): PEER, the Sufi title and Urdu/Persian given name (Wiktionary pir: GA /pɪɹ/)
readings.tech: PIR (any casing): P-I-R, passive infrared sensor / post-incident review, with its dictation fix

why: Split by casing (FIN-906). The names entry is case-sensitive and the app tries a case-sensitive key before a case-insensitive one of the same length, so 'Pir' reads as the name while 'PIR' and 'pir' keep the acronym. Tech text writes the acronym in capitals; leaving the tech entry case-insensitive keeps its lower-case reading and dictation casing fix.

readings.names: Gui (that casing only): GHEE, the Portuguese pet form of Guilherme and the Walloon Guy (Wiktionary /ˈɡi/)
readings.tech: GUI (any casing): GOO-ee, graphical user interface, with its dictation fix

why: Split by casing (FIN-906), as for Pir: 'Gui' reads as the name; 'GUI' and lower-case 'gui' (code, informal writing) keep GOO-ee and the dictation fix.
